reasoning_content:
Now let me do an end-to-end auth test: get a token from Keycloak for the frontend client using the admin user, then call a protected endpoint. First I need to check whether direct access grant is enabled for the frontend client.

Note the issuer in discovery returned "http://auth.localhost/realms/green-ecolution" (without port because Host header was auth.localhost). The backend config uses APP_AUTH__ISSUER_URL... but the running backend was started manually with APP_ENVIRONMENT=local. Let me test token flow via auth.localhost:3000.

action.command: cd /workspace && echo "=== token request (frontend client, admin user) ==="; curl -s -m 20 -X POST "http://localhost:3000/realms/green-ecolution/protocol/openid-connect/token" -H "Host: auth.localhost" -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=frontend&username=ge.admin&password=ge.admin" | head -c 600; echo
